Package dev.turboism.sdk.ui

Interface PanelView

All Known Implementing Classes:
PanelView.Button, PanelView.Chart, PanelView.CollapsibleSection, PanelView.Column, PanelView.Image, PanelView.Row, PanelView.Scroll, PanelView.Select, PanelView.Separator, PanelView.Text, PanelView.TextInput, PanelView.Toggle
public sealed interface PanelView permits PanelView.Column, PanelView.Row, PanelView.Text, PanelView.Image, PanelView.Button, PanelView.TextInput, PanelView.Select, PanelView.Toggle, PanelView.Chart, PanelView.CollapsibleSection, PanelView.Separator, PanelView.Scroll
Immutable, toolkit-neutral panel content rendered and owned by the runtime.
